verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks (webhooks or event hooks) that fire on user lifecycle or auth events. The closest item is diagnostic settings routing activity logs to endpoints for retention and insights, which is log export rather than a webhook subscription. Lifecycle workflows are internal automation, and the Graph API citations describe only request/response data access, so both are adjacent features rather than evidence of webhooks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
